[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Tohn Kalena''' was a former [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] before defecting to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He then commanded [[Watercrest Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Reyniu]].<ref name="Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook" />
